description: This file implements the CalendarRepository interface, providing methods to manage calendar events, leaves, and astrology details by interacting with DAOs (Data Access Objects). It includes functions for CRUD operations and fetching data within specific time periods.

classes.name: CalendarRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CalendarRepository interface managing calendar events, leaves, and astrology details via DAOs.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified time period.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Retrieves events occurring on a specific date.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event by its ID.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Gets events modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Fetches leaves within a specific time period.

methods.name: deleteLeave
methods.description: Deletes a leave by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leaves modified after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: getAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Fetches astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Gets astrology records modified after a specific timestamp.
